department: Artificial Intelligence (Barcelona School of Informatics, FIB)

deadline.value: Applications are accepted throughout the academic year under UPC's general rule; the programme page sets no separate date.
deadline.quote: As a general rule, you can apply for a doctoral programme throughout the academic year.

supervisor.value: Before acceptance, a programme teacher must agree in writing to supervise the PhD.
supervisor.quote: All candidates must have before being accepted a letter from a teacher in the program agreeing in supervising the PhD.

funding.value: Admission does not include tuition; grants and scholarships exist through UPC calls and some research groups, and the page does not say how many students receive one.
funding.quote: Acceptance in the program does not include any form of tuition.

also.quote: General calls of predoctoral grants, financed by state and autonomous public bodies, the UPC, and private foundations.

entry_route.value: The programme's ideal candidate holds a master's, most often in Computer Science or Artificial Intelligence.
entry_route.quote: the ideal background of a candidate for our program is a degree in Computer Science and a Master in Artificial Intelligence

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

english_waiver.value: Candidates must show English at B1 level; no certificate type or waiver for Indian or English-medium degrees is stated.

notes: Covers data science, machine learning and AI as a single UPC doctoral programme. Application deadlines are not on the programme admission page; the programme calendar shows only evaluation and thesis dates.
name: PhD in Artificial Intelligence
